description: Deterministic e2e scenario proving missing_input is explicit, uncited, and actionable via checklist and exception-level missing_doc UX.
overview: Protect the trust posture for missing inputs: when a referenced instrument PDF is missing, the UI must render a missing_input row with the exact answer string and zero citations, plus an actionable checklist (REA.pdf) and exception-level missing_doc callouts in the exceptions table payload.
goals: Prove missing_input invariants are visible and testable (exact answer string, zero citations).
Prove missing-doc guidance is actionable (filename + checklist copy) and exception-level UX surfaces missing_doc items.
Provide machine-executable acceptance criteria for automation.
nonGoals: Improving missing-doc detection recall/precision (this is a UX + invariant scenario).
DB-backed ingest/index pipeline and Quick Start workflow execution.
successMetrics: TB-MISSING-INPUT row renders with status missing_input, exact answer string, and zero citation chips.
Missing document checklist renders and includes REA.pdf.
Exceptions table renders a missing_doc item for the REA with a missing-instrument callout.
openQuestions: Should automation assert evidence signal details (source/page), or only the presence of REA.pdf in the checklist?

routes.name: Seeded Matters (Missing Input Pack)
routes.purpose: Render missing_input row + checklist and exceptions payload with missing_doc item.

stories.title: Missing Input Is Explicit and Actionable
stories.description: As a reviewer, when the pack is missing a referenced instrument PDF, I see a missing_input row with zero citations and an actionable checklist (REA.pdf), and the exceptions table surfaces the missing_doc item UX.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: Seed pack_02_missing_rea snapshot via `pnpm fixture:seed pack_02_missing_rea --overwrite` and run `pnpm dev` (dev-only routes).
Navigate to `/matters?pack=pack_02_missing_rea` and assert the `pack_id: pack_02_missing_rea` summary is visible.
Assert row `TB-MISSING-INPUT` exists with status `missing_input` and answer exactly `Not found in provided documents.`
Assert row `TB-MISSING-INPUT` renders zero citation chips: UI shows `(no citations)` and there are no anchors with text matching /^cit_/ in the row.
Assert `Missing document checklist` section is visible and contains a checklist item labeled `REA.pdf`.

Assert row `TS-04` renders the exceptions table payload and includes an item with type `Reciprocal Easement Agreement (REA)`, badge `missing_doc`, and a `Missing instrument document` callout referencing expected filename `REA.pdf`.
Negative: `missing_input` rows do not render a `Mark reviewed` button (only needs_review rows are reviewable).
